CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT: [redacted name] (Twin)
DATE OF BIRTH: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
REFERRING CLINICIAN: Dr. [redacted name]
DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Follow-up karyotype analysis requested following previous rapid PCR testing.

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

METHODOLOGY
Conventional cytogenetic analysis was performed on cultured peripheral blood lymphocytes. Metaphase chromosomes were G-banded and analyzed at 450-550 band resolution. A minimum of 20 cells were examined.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype.

INTERPRETATION
G-banded chromosome analysis shows a normal female karyotype without evidence of trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities. This level of analysis is sufficient to exclude numerical abnormalities and major structural rearrangements. Smaller structural abnormalities below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics (approximately 5-10 Mb) cannot be excluded.

This normal karyotype result excludes Down syndrome and other major chromosomal abnormalities detectable by conventional cytogenetic analysis.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorized by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
